newsitem.title: USA: US FERC approves NorAm, Houston Industries merger.
newsitem.headline: US FERC approves NorAm, Houston Industries merger.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission on Wednesday approved the proposed merger of NorAm Energy Corp with Houston Industries Inc .
The merger will form a $14.3 billion gas and electric company to serve 3.6 million customers in six states.
The Houston-based companies said they did not need FERC approval for their merger because the two companies are not subject to the commission's jurisdiction as utilities.

But they submitted their plans to the commission last March to ensure their merger was not delayed. The FERC last February suggested NorAm needed clearance for its power marketing arm, NorAm Energy Services, to become a utility subsidiary because FERC had authority over the NorAm unit's market-based sales.
